item.tib: dbal khyung dmar po'i sgrub gzhung
item.coloph: dbal khyung dmar po'i khod spungs zab gter nas/ drangs pa'i sgrub gzhung rnam gnyis dang / mnyam med shes rab rgyal mtshan gyis zur bskod (bkod) rnams/ gcig tu bsgrigs pa'i sgrab gzhung 'di ni/ dad ldan slob ma 'ga' zhig gi bskur ngor/ gshen gyi drang srong gnam bon rgya gar gyis(gyi) dbonaM ming dge sbyong pradz+nya nyi wer gyis/ bkra shis sman ri'i gnam bon rgya gar khang / pho brang rnam rgyal khang bzang gnas su bsgrigs/ nyes skyon ci mchis skyabs yul rnams la bshags/ dge bas (ba) 'gro rnams byang chub (thob) phyir bsngo//
